camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public UpdateCalendar --region cn-hangzhou --Type StrongConstraint --Owner 123456789 --Description '工作日调度日历' --Id 12345 --SchedulePolicy '{"SkipDates":["2026-10-08"],"NormalDates":["2026-10-08"]}'
description_en: Updates a scheduling calendar. This is a full update that requires you to submit the complete editable configuration
description_zh: 更新调度日历。全量修改，需提交完整的可编辑配置
name: UpdateCalendar

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduling calendar
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the calendar applies to all workspaces. Default value: false. Valid values:
true: All workspaces.
false: The workspaces specified by ProjectIds
parameters.help_zh:
是否适用于全部工作空间，默认值为 false。

true：全部工作空间。
false：ProjectIds 指定的工作空间
parameters.name: all_projects

parameters.help_en:
The list of applicable workspace IDs.
Required and cannot be empty when AllProjects is set to false or left unspecified.
Leave empty or pass an empty array when AllProjects is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
适用的工作空间 ID 列表。

AllProjects 为 false 或未填写时：必填且不能为空。
AllProjects 为 true 时：不填或传空数组
parameters.name: project_ids

parameters.help_en:
The calendar type. Valid values:
StrongConstraint: Strong constraint calendar.
WeakConstraint: Weak constraint calendar
parameters.help_zh:
日历类型。

StrongConstraint：强约束日历。
WeakConstraint：弱约束日历
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The start date of the calendar validity period, in the `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Required when Type is set to StrongConstraint
parameters.help_zh: 日历有效期的开始日期，格式为 `yyyy-mm-dd`。Type 为 StrongConstraint 时必填
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the calendar validity period, in the `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Required when Type is set to StrongConstraint. The end date cannot be earlier than the start date, and the interval between the start date and the end date must be less than 5 years
parameters.help_zh: 日历有效期的结束日期，格式为 `yyyy-mm-dd`。Type 为 StrongConstraint 时必填。结束日期不得早于开始日期，且与开始日期的间隔须小于 5 年
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The expiration reminder. Required when Type is set to StrongConstraint. Valid values:
OneMonthBefore: One month in advance.
OneWeekBefore: One week in advance.
ThreeDaysBefore: Three days in advance
parameters.help_zh:
到期提醒，Type 为 StrongConstraint 时必填。

OneMonthBefore：提前一个月。
OneWeekBefore：提前一周。
ThreeDaysBefore：提前三天
parameters.name: expiration_reminder

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling policy after the calendar expires. Required when Type is set to StrongConstraint. Valid values:
Normal: Normal scheduling.
Pause: Pause scheduling.
Skip: Dry run
parameters.help_zh:
日历过期后的调度策略，Type 为 StrongConstraint 时必填。

Normal：正常调度。
Pause：暂停调度。
Skip：空跑
parameters.name: overdue_policy

fields.help_en: The list of normal scheduling dates
fields.name: normal_dates

fields.help_en: The list of non-scheduling dates. Tasks perform dry runs on these dates. Used only for strong constraint calendars
fields.help_zh: 非调度日期列表，任务在这些日期空跑。仅强约束日历使用
fields.name: skip_dates

parameters.help_en: The date scheduling policy. For a strong constraint calendar, the normal scheduling dates and non-scheduling dates must cover every day within the validity period and cannot overlap
parameters.help_zh: 日期调度策略。强约束日历的正常调度日期和非调度日期须覆盖有效期内每一天，且不能重叠
parameters.name: schedule_policy

parameters.help_en:
The default scheduling policy for dates that are not configured. Required when Type is set to WeakConstraint. Valid values:
Normal: Normal scheduling.
Pause: Pause scheduling.
Skip: Dry run
parameters.help_zh:
未设置日期的默认调度策略，Type 为 WeakConstraint 时必填。

Normal：正常调度。
Pause：暂停调度。
Skip：空跑
parameters.name: fallback_policy

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The description of the scheduling calendar. The description must be 5 to 2,048 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 调度日历描述，长度为5～2048个字符
parameters.name: description

RequestId.title_en: 请求的 ID，用于定位日志，排查问题。
RequestId.title_zh: 请求的 ID，用于定位日志，排查问题。
